answer.rationale: Renew the incumbent as the least-risk decision within the 14-day expiry window and with the assembly line at 94% committed volume. The incumbent's price refusal means this will not satisfy the full 18% spend-cut mandate, so the cost gap is explicitly flagged. A primary-vendor switch may offer lower unit cost, but the inherited evidence does not establish delivery performance under current line-critical conditions; a disruption would create greater total-cost exposure than the known price premium. Verify the incumbent stability record before commitment.
